records.jp: ――あたしは
records.en_original: I—
records.en: I—

records.jp: お互いに目標に向かって進んでいる限り……<CR>またいつか、どこかで会うこともあるだろう
records.en_original: And as long as we all keep working toward our own goals, our paths may very well cross again one day.
records.en: As long as we keep moving toward our goals...<CR>we may meet again somewhere, someday.

records.jp: ……うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: ...Yeah!

records.jp: あたしは、進み続ける
records.en_original: I'm going to keep moving forward.
records.en: I'll keep moving forward.

records.jp: ライザさん……
records.en_original: Ryza...
records.en: Ryza-san...

records.jp: クーケン島っていう、なんてことない島の<CR>ラーゼンボーデンっていう、なんてことない村
records.en_original: On an ordinary island called Kurken Island, in the ordinary village of Rasenboden,
records.en: On the unremarkable island called Kurken Island<CR>was the unremarkable village of Rasenboden.

records.jp: そんな村を飛び出したあたしは、<CR>ひょんなことから、とんでもない大冒険をした
records.en_original: I left that village, and found myself, by chance, dropped into an extraordinary adventure.
records.en: I left that village<CR>and, by chance, embarked on an incredible adventure.

records.jp: 数多くの人々が暮らす大都市のすぐそばで、<CR>誰も知らない、あたしたちだけの大冒険を
records.en_original: Right next to a huge, bustling metropolis, we had an adventure nobody else knew about, an adventure that was just for us.
records.en: Right beside a great city where countless people lived,<CR>we had an adventure no one knew about—one that belonged only to us.

records.jp: そこであたしはたくさんの出会いを得た。<CR>そして、別れも
records.en_original: I had many new encounters...and many sad goodbyes.
records.en: There, I met so many people.<CR>And said goodbye to them too.

records.jp: たとえ一時だけの冒険だとしても……<CR>そこで得た『思い出』は一生のもの
records.en_original: Even if our adventure ended... The memories we made are forever.
records.en: Even if the adventure lasted only a little while...<CR>the memories we made there would last a lifetime.

records.jp: そうでしょ？
records.en_original: Isn't that right?
records.en: Right?

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: —Huh?

records.jp: 消え、ちゃった
records.en_original: She's gone.
records.en: She... disappeared.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: Ao?
records.en: Ao-chan?

records.jp: 『想い』は一生のもの……
records.en_original: Memories are forever...
records.en: "Feelings" last a lifetime...

records.jp: きっと最後の言葉も、<CR>私に向けたものじゃなかったんだろうけど
records.en_original: I'm sure she didn't mean to say that to us.
records.en: I'm sure those final words<CR>weren't meant for me, but...

records.jp: でも……なんか、大切なことを教わった気がする
records.en_original: Even so, I feel like I learned something important.
records.en: Still... I feel like she taught me something important.

records.jp: 私たちも、いつかはお別れになるかもしれないけど……<CR>今この時を楽しく過ごせるようにしたいね
records.en_original: There may come a time where we have to say goodbye... Which is why we should be sure to enjoy the time we have together.
records.en: We might have to say goodbye someday too...<CR>so I want us to enjoy the time we have now.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>この再接続による安定性低下の心配はありません
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. This reconnection has caused no instability in the world structure.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed.<CR>This reconnection poses no risk to stability.

records.jp: 再接続……
records.en_original: Reconnection...
records.en: Reconnection...

records.jp: あたしたちも、ライザさんと出会えてよかった！
records.en_original: I'm glad we got to meet Ryza!
records.en: We're glad we met you too, Ryza-san!

records.jp: けど……結局、<CR>このココロトープってなんだったんだろうね？
records.en_original: But... Why did this Heartscape appear in the first place?
records.en: But... in the end,<CR>what was this Heartscape?

records.jp: 分かんない
records.en_original: I don't know.
records.en: I don't know.

records.jp: どこかずっと遠くに住んでいるのかもしれないし、<CR>全部私たちが見た空想なのかもしれないけど
records.en_original: It's possible that she's out there somewhere far away, or maybe what we saw wasn't even real.
records.en: Maybe she lives somewhere far away,<CR>or maybe everything we saw was only our imagination.

records.jp: そこは、なんでもいいかな。<CR>想いは、ちゃんと受け取ったから
records.en_original: But that doesn't matter. Those emotions were real.
records.en: I don't think it matters.<CR>Her feelings reached us.

records.jp: ん、そだね！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah, exactly!

records.jp: 「ライザ」という女性がどこに住む何者なのか、<CR>このココロトープにどんな意味があったのか
records.en_original: Who is Ryza? Where is she from? Why did the Heartscape appear?
records.en: Who was this woman named Ryza, and where did she live?<CR>What meaning did this Heartscape have?

records.jp: 結局それは、分からないまま終わった
records.en_original: There's a lot we still don't know.
records.en: In the end, we never found out.

records.jp: でも、きっとこの出会いには何かの意味がある。<CR>私は大切なことを教わった気がしていた
records.en_original: Still, this all must mean something. I learned a lot.
records.en: But I'm sure this encounter meant something.<CR>I felt as though I had learned something important.

records.jp: 出会いは一期一会、思い出は一生
records.en_original: We may only be together for a short time, but our memories will last forever.
records.en: Every encounter is once in a lifetime, but memories last forever.

records.jp: 私たちは、ライザさんが歩んだ冒険に想いを馳せる――
records.en_original: We're going to carry on these feelings that Ryza felt during her adventure.
records.en: We let our thoughts drift to the adventure Ryza-san had lived through—

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>世界を超えた想い<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>World Transcendent Feelings<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>World Transcendent Feelings<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
